_note: Workout section (/workouts/). Exercises: names, cues and reps come from the carousel factory (E:/kmh-video-gen/catalog.js); pictures are the 'anatomy' character (assets/workouts/anatomy/<id>.webp, two poses = start -> finish). Wording rule: technique cues only, no health promises. Built by scripts/build-workouts.mjs.

kegelLying.name: Kegel (lying)
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat
Squeeze as if stopping your pee and lift up and in
kegelLying.tip: Breathe normally. If your belly, glutes or thighs tense up, the squeeze is too hard: go lighter.

kegelSitting.name: Kegel (sitting)
cues: Squeeze and lift, keep glutes soft
kegelSitting.tip: Do it on a chair, in a car or at a desk: nobody can see it. Keep your shoulders loose.

kegelStanding.name: Kegel (standing)
cues: Squeeze and lift up and in
Keep your belly and glutes relaxed
kegelStanding.tip: The hardest position because gravity works against you. Master the lying version first.

breathing.name: Belly Breathing
breathing.tip: Let the pelvic floor soften on the inhale. This is as important as the squeeze.

bridge.name: Glute Bridge
bridge.short: Lift hips, squeeze at the top
cues: Exhale, squeeze and lift your hips

mistake.wrong: Arching your lower back at the top
mistake.right: Ribs down, straight line from knees to shoulders

bridgeBall.name: Bridge + Ball Squeeze
bridgeBall.short: Bridge with a ball between knees
cues: Ball or pillow between your knees
bridgeBall.tip: No ball? Use a pillow or a rolled-up towel between your knees.

singleLegBridge.name: Single-Leg Bridge
singleLegBridge.short: One foot down, one leg up
cues: One leg straight in the air

bridgeMarch.name: Bridge March
cues: Lift one foot, then the other

heelSlides.name: Heel Slides
heelSlides.short: Slide one heel out and back
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent

supineMarch.name: Supine March
supineMarch.short: Lift bent knees one at a time
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent

deadBug.name: Dead Bug
cues: Lower back stays on the floor

mistake.wrong: Lower back lifting off the floor
mistake.right: Press your back down and move slower

pelvicTilt.name: Pelvic Tilts
pelvicTilt.short: Tilt your pelvis up and down
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent
Flatten your lower back to the floor

kneeFallout.name: Knee Fallouts
kneeFallout.short: Let one knee drop to the side
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent

clamshell.name: Clamshell
clamshell.short: Open the top knee, feet together
cues: Lie on your side, knees bent
Feet together, lift the top knee

sideLegRaise.name: Side Leg Raise
sideLegRaise.short: Lift the top leg straight up
cues: Lie on your side, legs straight

birdDog.name: Bird Dog
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips
Reach opposite arm and leg long

catCow.name: Cat-Cow
cues: Inhale: drop your belly, look up
catCow.tip: Move slowly and match the movement to your breath.

plank.name: Plank
plank.tip: If the full version is too hard, drop to your knees. A clean short hold beats a sagging long one.

sidePlank.name: Side Plank
cues: Lift hips into a straight line

superman.name: Superman
superman.short: Lift arms and legs off the floor
cues: Lift arms, chest and legs a little

childPose.name: Child's Pose
childPose.tip: Let your belly and pelvic floor fully relax here. Do not push into any pain.

happyBaby.name: Happy Baby
cues: Hold your feet, knees toward armpits

butterfly.name: Butterfly Stretch
cues: Sit tall, soles of feet together

squat.name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Exhale and lift as you stand

wallSit.name: Wall Sit
cues: Add a Kegel squeeze while holding
wallSit.tip: Stop before your thighs shake hard. Breathe the whole time.

ballSqueeze.name: Ball Squeeze
ballSqueeze.tip: No ball? A rolled-up towel or a pillow works too.

programs.title: Pelvic Floor Exercises for Men: 6-Move Beginner Routine

programs.lede: Six simple moves for the pelvic floor and the muscles around it. Each one has a start and finish picture with the working muscles highlighted, three technique cues and the reps.

Rest about 30 seconds between moves.

Three to four times a week is a good start; quality beats speed.
